name: Maine Solar Solutions
old_description: You can lower your utility costs and achieve energy independence, for your home or business. We’re here for your entire solar journey—from your free assessment to your final panel and beyond.
about:
Maine Solar Solutions was founded in 2012 by Sam Zuckerman, who began the business from a garage in Portland, Maine. The company is now headquartered in Freeport, with operations also in Brunswick, and remains a locally owned enterprise focused on renewable energy installations across the state.

The firm provides full-service solar electric system design, installation, and ongoing maintenance for residential, commercial, and new-construction projects. Its offerings include rooftop and ground-mount solar arrays, battery backup systems, off-grid installations, electric-vehicle charger setup, and general electrical contracting. Since inception, the company has completed over 3,500 solar installations totaling 8.2 megawatts of capacity, covering the equivalent of nearly 20 football fields of rooftop panels.

Customers range from individual homeowners in towns such as Lisbon, Yarmouth, Kennebunk, and Cape Elizabeth to businesses seeking to reduce operating costs through federal tax incentives. The company also works with builders on new-construction projects to integrate solar from the outset.

Zuckerman started the venture to help Mainers lower utility bills and achieve energy independence while reducing environmental impact. Maine Solar Solutions differentiates itself with a 30-year labor and parts warranty, a Maine-based team that handles permitting, utility interconnection, and long-term service, and a track record as one of the state’s longest-operating solar providers.
